title: Loot Shelf
description: Lean 5e-only loot containers and merchant shelf. A chest is an actor on the scene: token art swaps closed/open/empty, owners loot through the system's own sheets, and drags out of a container default to move instead of copy. Merchants get one clean shelf window: browsable stock with prices, a buy flow that checks coin and hands the item over GM-side, selling back at a configurable rate, and a per-item hide-from-shelf flag. Native ApplicationV2 UI, plain game.socket GM proxy, no dependencies.
